name: 4K Real-ESRGAN Video Upscaler
description: Automated FFmpeg pipeline for high-fidelity 2K/4K upscaling using anime and photo models.
tagline: A repeatable media pipeline for turning low-resolution footage into high-fidelity video.
about: This utility combines FFmpeg preparation with Real-ESRGAN inference so media can be upscaled consistently without repeating manual conversion and model-selection steps.

steps.desc: Choose a source video and select the appropriate model profile.
The pipeline extracts frames, processes them, and preserves the source audio.
Review the generated 2K or 4K output and save the finished video.
